description: This source file implements server-side logic for a user profile page in a SvelteKit application. It includes a load function to retrieve user profile data from a Django REST API, and an action to update the profile with form validation and API communication.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches user profile data from the Django REST API, processes the response, and returns user data structured for the client-side component.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Handles form submission to update the user's profile, including validation, formatting, and API request to update data on the server.

calls: apiRequest('/profile/', { method: 'PATCH', body: djangoData }, { cookies, org })
